title.english: The Warmth That Takes Its Time

pairs.target: bái lǎoshī bǎ liǎngzhī wēndù xiāngtóng de shuǐguàn fàngzài zhuōshàng , wèn tǎ wéi nǎyìzhī lǐtou de tóng gān gèng huì chuánrè .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai set two water jars of equal temperature on the table and asked Tavi which one's copper rod conducted heat better.
pairs.hanzi: 白老师把两只温度相同的水罐放在桌上，问塔维哪一只里头的铜杆更会传热。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi zhǐ , xiān kàn biǎo shàng yǒuméiyǒu gāngcái de jìlù . pángbiān de tèlún yǐjīng xiào le , bái lǎoshī quèshuō , bié zhǐgù xiào , zìjǐ yě bùxǔ cāi .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't point, first looking for the preceding records on the sheet. Teren beside him was already laughing, but Instructor Bai said not to just laugh: he wasn't allowed to guess either.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没指，先看表上有没有刚才的记录。旁边的特伦已经笑了，白老师却说，别只顾笑，自己也不许猜。

pairs.target: zhè táng shì huíxiào qījiān bǔ shàng de fùxí kè . tǎ wéi líkāi bái lǎoshī de táizi yǐ guò le yígèduōyuè , shǒu hái jìde zhōngyāng nà liǎngchù néng pèng , yǎnjīng què chàdiǎn bǎ zhuōshàng huàn le wèizhì de dúshù biǎo rènchéng yuánlái de shùnxù .
pairs.english: This was a refresher during his school visit. More than a month away from Instructor Bai's bench, Tavi's hands remembered the two central contact patches, but he almost mistook the moved reading sheets for their old order.
pairs.hanzi: 这堂是回校期间补上的复习课。塔维离开白老师的台子已过了一个多月，手还记得中央那两处能碰，眼睛却差点把桌上换了位置的读数表认成原来的顺序。

pairs.target: tā jiāng biǎo zhuǎnguò lái , bǎ zuǒyòu gè biāo yìbǐ , cái zuòxià zhòngdú .
pairs.english: He turned the sheets, marked left and right, then sat to read again.
pairs.hanzi: 他将表转过来，把左右各标一笔，才坐下重读。

pairs.target: wàitou de wēnshuǐ hé lěng dài gèzì wéichí xiǎoxiǎode wēnchā , tóng gān shì lǎoshī hé guò cáizhì yǔ zhěngkuài tǐjī de nà yíduì , rè duān yǒu dǎng hù , búràng rén shēnshǒu qù pèng .
pairs.english: The external warm water and cold bags maintained modest temperature gradients. The copper rods were the teacher-checked pair of known material and whole volume, their hot ends guarded against touch.
pairs.hanzi: 外头的温水和冷袋各自维持小小的温差，铜杆是老师核过材质与整块体积的那一对，热端有挡护，不让人伸手去碰。

pairs.target: pǔtōng zhuàngtài xiān jì yìhuí , zài fàng shàng liǎngshǒu , bú jiè xìng , zài jì yìhuí .
pairs.english: They recorded the ordinary state first, then recorded again with both hands resting on the rods without borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 普通状态先记一回，再放上两手，不借性，再记一回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fāxiàn qízhōng yìbiān shēng dé lüè kuài , bái lǎoshī ràng tā kàn shíjiān : zhè yícì qǐ dú chí le , bùnéng jiāng xiān liúguòqù de nà yìdiǎn yě jì chéng zìjǐ zuò de .
pairs.english: Tavi noticed one side rising slightly faster. Instructor Bai had him check the time: he'd started this reading late and couldn't claim that earlier flow as his own doing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维发现其中一边升得略快，白老师让他看时间：这一次起读迟了，不能将先流过去的那一点也记成自己做的。

pairs.target: děng shuǐ zhòngzhì , dúshù wěn le , tā cái zhǔnxǔ zìjǐ shì .
pairs.english: Only after the water was reset and the readings steady did he allow himself to try.
pairs.hanzi: 等水重置、读数稳了，他才准许自己试。

pairs.target: búshì jiāng rè cóng yíkuài tóng lǐ zhuā chūlái sāijìn lìng yíkuài , gèng búshì shǐ zhǐjiān hūlěnghūrè .
pairs.english: It wasn't grabbing heat from one copper rod and stuffing it into the other, much less making his fingertips hot and cold.
pairs.hanzi: 不是将热从一块铜里抓出来塞进另一块，更不是使指尖忽冷忽热。

pairs.target: tā wéichí liǎngchù jiēchù , zhī ràng yuánlái wēnchā xià de chuánrè kuàimàn chūxiàn yìdiǎn hùbǔ de piānyí . biǎo shàng de biànhuà láide chí , tǎ wéi zhàojiù děng zhe , méiyǒu wèi děng dé jiǔ biàn zài tiān lì .
pairs.english: He maintained both contacts, allowing only a small complementary shift in heat-flow rates under the existing gradient. The readings changed slowly; Tavi waited without pushing harder because it took time.
pairs.hanzi: 他维持两处接触，只让原来温差下的传热快慢出现一点互补的偏移。表上的变化来得迟，塔维照旧等着，没有为等得久便再添力。

pairs.target: bái lǎoshī dúwán , tā zài liǎngshǒu réng tiēzhe tóng gān shí shōuhuí , cái sōngkāi shǒu .
pairs.english: When Instructor Bai finished reading, he canceled while both hands still touched the rods, only then releasing them.
pairs.hanzi: 白老师读完，他在两手仍贴着铜杆时收回，才松开手。

pairs.target: chóngxīn huàn hǎo wàitou de shuǐ , děng guò yíduàn , zài chá pǔtōng shí de sùlǜ , yuánlái de guānxì huílái le . zhè yìhuí yě zhī zuò le zhè yícì , zuòxià xiē yǎn shí , chuāngwài yǐjīng yǒurén tí zhe fàntǒng guòqù .
pairs.english: After resetting the external water and waiting, they checked the ordinary rates again: the original relationship returned. That was his only trial. As he sat to rest his eyes, someone was already carrying a food pail past the window.
pairs.hanzi: 重新换好外头的水，等过一段，再查普通时的速率，原来的关系回来了。这一回也只做了这一次，坐下歇眼时，窗外已经有人提着饭桶过去。

pairs.target: tèlún jiāng zìjǐ de biǎo tuī yuǎn , ràngchū yíkuài kòng dìfāng gěi tā . tǎ wéi wèn tā xiànzài hái xiǎng qù kàn nǎ chù shí zuò , tā shuō zìjǐ xiǎng zhǎo zuò chǔ shí kù de , nǎpà xiān gēn rén chá yíjì qiángfèng , yě bǐ zhěngtiān zhuī zhe tiānqì pǎo qiáng .
pairs.english: Teren moved his sheet to make room for him. Tavi asked what placement work he wanted to see now. He wanted food-storage work; even spending a season checking wall gaps with someone beat chasing weather all day.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦将自己的表推远，让出一块空地方给他。塔维问他现在还想去看哪处实作，他说自己想找做储食库的，哪怕先跟人查一季墙缝，也比整天追着天气跑强。

pairs.target: " nǐ bùxiǎng chūmén ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " xiǎng . wǒ xiǎng tiāo tiān hǎo de shíhòu chūmén . gēn nǐ bù yíyàng , nǐ jìngrán yuànyì ná tā dāng huó . "
pairs.english: “You don't want to go out?” Tavi asked. “I do. When the weather's good. Unlike you, who actually wants it as a job.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你不想出门？”塔维问。
“想。我想挑天好的时候出门。跟你不一样，你竟然愿意拿它当活。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , shuō zìjǐ hái méiyǒu gēn nài lěi zǒuguò zhèhuí shuǐlù , yě bù zhīdào yílùshang huì buhuì bàoyuàn .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and said he hadn't yet taken this water route with Nerai and didn't know whether he'd complain along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，说自己还没有跟奈蕾走过这回水路，也不知道一路上会不会抱怨。

pairs.target: tèlún shuō ruò bàoyuàn , huílái jìde xiě , bié bǎ quánbù hǎokàn de gěi rén kàn , huàitiānqì zhī liúgěi xiézǐ .
pairs.english: Teren said if he did complain, remember to write it down on return, not show people all the pretty things and leave the bad weather only to his shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦说若抱怨，回来记得写，别把全部好看的给人看，坏天气只留给鞋子。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhèhuà shí zhèng jiāng zìjǐ de xuēzǐ dǎo guòlái dǒu , yìxiǎo lì kǎ zài xiégēn lǐ de shízǐ diào dào zhuōxià , tán le liǎngcì , shuí yě méi jiǎn zhe .
pairs.english: As he spoke he shook his boot upside down. A little stone lodged in its heel fell under the table, bounced twice, and escaped both of them.
pairs.hanzi: 他说这话时正将自己的靴子倒过来抖，一小粒卡在鞋跟里的石子掉到桌下，弹了两次，谁也没捡着。

pairs.target: bái lǎoshī shōu hǎo jìlù , tīngjiàn tāmen shuō qùxiàng , zhī wèn zhècì dài shénme yíqì . tǎ wéi shuō shì chǐ , túbǎn hé chāo jì de zhǐ , tiě duì liúxiào .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai put away the records, heard their talk of destinations, and only asked what instruments he was taking. Tavi said a ruler, drawing board, and paper for notes; the iron pair stayed at school.
pairs.hanzi: 白老师收好记录，听见他们说去向，只问这次带什么仪器。塔维说是尺、图板和抄记的纸，铁对留校。

pairs.target: tā diǎndiǎntóu , méiyǒu jiāng zhuōshàng nà diǎn chuánrè de běnlǐng lìngwài xǔchéng kěyòng zài lùbiān shuǐhú lǐ de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She nodded without turning that small heat-conduction skill on the bench into leave to use it on a roadside kettle.
pairs.hanzi: 她点点头，没有将桌上那点传热的本领另外许成可用在路边水壶里的东西。

pairs.target: wǔfàn shí mǐlā ná zhe liǎngkuài bùtóng hòu de mùpiàn lái , zuòxià cái wèn zhuōshàng néng bunéng yǒu yíkuài bù zhān tāng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: At lunch Mira arrived with two pieces of wood of different thicknesses, sat down, then asked if the table had a soup-free space.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭时米拉拿着两块不同厚的木片来，坐下才问桌上能不能有一块不沾汤的地方。

pairs.target: tā de bǐng hái dé huí zuōfang zuò yíduàn fǎnfù kāihé de jiǎnchá , tánhuà shí yǒurén tíchū , néng ràng yíwèi shìyòngzhě zuò wán liǎnghuí , bù děngyú néng zài zhùhù shǒulǐ chēng wán yíjì .
pairs.english: Her handle needed repeated opening-and-closing tests back at the workshop. At the review someone had said two complete turns by one user didn't equal lasting a season in a household's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 她的柄还得回作坊做一段反复开合的检查，谈话时有人提出，能让一位试用者做完两回，不等于能在住户手里撑完一季。

pairs.target: tā jiǎng dé yǒuxiē búnàifán , yòu shuō nà rén wèn dé quèshí yǒu dàolǐ .
pairs.english: She sounded a little impatient, then said the question really was fair.
pairs.hanzi: 她讲得有些不耐烦，又说那人问得确实有道理。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng wǎn nuókāi , wèn tā huì buhuì gēnzhe zìjǐ qù shuǐbiān kànkàn , huà yì chūkǒu biàn juéde xiàng yǐ tì biérén xuǎn hǎo le rìzi .
pairs.english: Tavi moved his bowl and asked if she'd come see the water with him, then felt as soon as he'd spoken that he'd chosen someone else's dates for them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将碗挪开，问她会不会跟着自己去水边看看，话一出口便觉得像已替别人选好了日子。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ liǎngkuài mùpiàn bìng qí , méi táitóu , shuō zìjǐ hái méi xué wán xiǎng xué de , jiùsuàn yào qù , yě xiǎng dài zhe néng yòng de dōngxī qù .
pairs.english: Mira aligned the wood pieces without looking up. She said she hadn't finished learning what she wanted; even if she went, she wanted to bring something useful.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把两块木片并齐，没抬头，说自己还没学完想学的，就算要去，也想带着能用的东西去。

pairs.target: " búshì shuō nǐ de chǐ bùnéng yòng . " tā yòu tiān yíjù , " shì wǒ de bǐng hái méi hǎo . "
pairs.english: “Not that your ruler isn't useful,” she added. “My handle isn't ready yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是说你的尺不能用。”她又添一句，“是我的柄还没好。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ míngbái , yòu jiǎng le tèlún zhī xiǎng tiāo qíngtiān chūmén . mǐlā tīng wán , shuō nà dǎo tǐng cōngming , shuí yě bùnéng yīnwèi yǒurén huì gǎn yǔ lù , biàn bǎ yǔ dōu ānpái gěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi said he understood, then told her Teren wanted to go out only in fine weather. Mira said that was smart: just because someone could travel in rain didn't mean all the rain should be assigned to him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己明白，又讲了特伦只想挑晴天出门。米拉听完，说那倒挺聪明，谁也不能因为有人会赶雨路，便把雨都安排给他。

pairs.target: tā zài mùpiàn shàng zuò le gè xiǎo jìhào , zhèngqiǎo yǒurén jīngguò pèng le zhuōbiān , hòu de nà kuài lì zhù , báo de dǎo le , pā dì luò jìn kōng wǎn lǐ .
pairs.english: She made a little mark on the wood. Just then someone passing bumped the table; the thick piece stood, the thin one toppled and clattered into an empty bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 她在木片上作了个小记号，正巧有人经过碰了桌边，厚的那块立住，薄的倒了，啪地落进空碗里。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dītóu kàn le yíhuìer . mǐlā shēnshǒu bǎ tā līn chūlái , shuōhǎo , bānyùn zhīwài , yòu tiān yìtiáo bié zài fànzhuō shàng bǎiyàng .
pairs.english: They stared down a while. Mira lifted it out: fine, beyond transport, add another rule against displaying samples on the dinner table.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人低头看了一会儿。米拉伸手把它拎出来，说好，搬运之外，又添一条别在饭桌上摆样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé duān bù wěn wǎn , zhǐhǎo xiān fàngxià , tì tā bǎ xiùkǒu biān nà kuài gānjìng dìfāng téngchūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed too hard to hold his bowl steady and had to set it down, clearing the clean space by her cuff for her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得端不稳碗，只好先放下，替她把袖口边那块干净地方腾出来。
